# Acquire complete data from the arcgis map
```{r}
intersection_url <- "https://services6.arcgis.com/yG5s3afENB5iO9fj/arcgis/rest/services/survey123_84951e642e3a49998a9cfba407142ac5_results/FeatureServer/0/query"
street_url <- "https://services6.arcgis.com/yG5s3afENB5iO9fj/arcgis/rest/services/survey123_da9c3d28841f484e8cd88f960513d183_results/FeatureServer/0/query"

download_arcgis <- function(url, geometry_type = c("street", "intersection"), batch_size = 1000) {
  geometry_type <- match.arg(geometry_type)
  offset <- 0
  features <- list()

  repeat {
    r <- GET(url, query = list(where = "1=1", outFields = "*", returnGeometry = TRUE, orderByFields = "objectid ASC", resultOffset = offset, resultRecordCount = batch_size, f = "json"))
    x <- fromJSON(content(r, "text"), simplifyDataFrame = FALSE)
    n <- length(x$features)
    cat("Offset:", offset, " Returned:", n, "\n")

    if (n == 0)
      break

    features <- c(features, x$features)
    offset <- offset + n
  }

  cat("Total features downloaded:", length(features), "\n")

  # Attributes
  attributes <- map_dfr(features,
    ~{attrs <- .x$attributes
      attrs[map_lgl(attrs, is.null)] <- NA
      as_tibble(attrs)})

  # Geometry
  if (geometry_type == "intersection") {
    geometry <- st_sfc(map(features, ~st_point(c(.x$geometry$x, .x$geometry$y))), crs = 4326)
  } else if (geometry_type == "street") {
    geometry <- st_sfc(map(
      features, function(f) {
      paths <- f$geometry$paths
      # Convert each path in the array into a coordinate matrix
      lines <- lapply(seq_len(dim(paths)[1]), function(i) {
        paths[i, , ]})

      if (length(lines) == 1) {
        st_linestring(lines[[1]])
      } else {
        st_multilinestring(lines)}}),
    crs = 4326)}

  st_as_sf(bind_cols(attributes, geometry = geometry))
}

intersection_sf <- download_arcgis(intersection_url, geometry_type = "intersection")
street_sf <- download_arcgis(street_url, geometry_type = "street")

intersection_sf <- intersection_sf |> mutate(feature_type = "Intersection")
street_sf <- street_sf |> mutate(feature_type = "Street")

honorary_sf <- bind_rows(intersection_sf, street_sf)
```

# Clean and filter
```{r}
# Reformat dates & remove extra spaces
honorary_sf <- honorary_sf %>%
  mutate(
    creation_dt = as.POSIXct(CreationDate / 1000, origin = '1970-01-01', tz = 'UTC'),
    edit_dt = as.POSIXct(EditDate / 1000, origin = '1970-01-01', tz = 'UTC'),
    enactment_dt = as.POSIXct(enactment_date / 1000, origin = '1970-01-01', tz = 'UTC'),
    enactment_date = as.Date(enactment_dt), # Date only
    enactment_year = as.integer(format(enactment_date, '%Y')) # Calendar year
  ) %>%
  mutate(new_name = str_squish(new_name))

# Filter to post-9/11, drop duplicates in relevant columns
hits <- honorary_sf %>% filter(enactment_date >= as.Date("2001/09/11"))  %>%
  select(new_name, biographical_information, limits, borough, zip_code, enactment_year, present_name, category, introduced_by_council_members, geometry) %>%
  unique()

# Search for mention of 9/11 in bio or name
date <- hits %>%
  filter(str_detect(str_to_lower(biographical_information), '9/11|9-11|9\\.11|september 11') |
    str_detect(str_to_lower(new_name), '9/11|9-11|9\\.11|september 11'))

# Search for bios that don't mention 9/11 explicitly but contain related phrases
keywords <- regex("world trade center|wtc|twin towers|ground zero", ignore_case = TRUE)
exclude <- regex("9/11|september 11|9-11|9.11", ignore_case = TRUE)
# Also see these whitelisted names uncovered in voices project
other_hits <- honorary_sf %>% filter(
  (str_detect(biographical_information, keywords) & !str_detect(biographical_information, exclude)) |
  new_name %in% c("Carl Allen Peralta Street", "Captain Vincent F. Giammona Way", "Craig W. Staub Way", "Lt. Dennis Mojica Corner",
                  "Frances Horos Street", "John Patrick Burnside Way", "Josh Rosenthal Way", "Lorraine Lee Way",

                  "Peter Raimondi Way", "Richard Allen Pearlman Lane", "Rosemary Ann Smith Place", "Firefighter Timothy M. Welty Street",
                  "Firefighter Thomas R. Kelly Avenue", "Christopher Racaniello 9/11 Memorial Way", "Vincent Laieta Jr., Way", "Arthur Warren Scullin Way",
                  "Jody Tepedino 9-11 Memorial Way")
  ) %>%
    select(new_name, biographical_information, limits, borough, zip_code, enactment_year, present_name, category, introduced_by_council_members, geometry) %>%
  unique()

final <- rbind(date, other_hits)
```

# Clean and merge coded data
```{r}
# Read in coded data, having removed dupes, corrected typos, selected the most relevant CM, and categorized memorials
total_edits <- read_xlsx("../data/total_edits.xlsx")

# Dedupe names in total (and fix voicescenter misspellings)
total <- total %>%
  mutate(
    new_name = case_when(
      new_name == "Memorial Treeway of Champion Trees: Calvary Cemetary" ~ "Memorial Treeway of Champion Trees: Calvary Cemetery",
      new_name == "Conseleya 9/11 Memorial" ~ "Conselyea 9/11 Memorial",
      new_name == "Fort Greene Park Groove of Trees" ~ "Fort Greene Park Grove of Trees",
      new_name == "Forest Park Memorial Drive" & introduced_by_council_members == "Holden" ~ "Forest Park Memorial Drive (Outside Park)",
      new_name == "Forest Park Memorial Drive" & introduced_by_council_members == "Crowley " ~ "Forest Park Memorial Drive (Inside Park)",
      new_name == "Giuseppa Vendome Way" & limits == "At the intersection of 24th Avenue and Crescent Street" ~ "Giuseppa Vendome Way (Crescent St)",
      new_name == "Giuseppa Vendome Way" & limits == "At the intersection of 24th Avenue and 26th Street" ~ "Giuseppa Vendome Way (26th St)",
      new_name == "Officer Glen Pettit Corner" & limits == "At the northwest corner of East 21st Street and 2nd Avenue" ~ "Officer Glen Pettit Corner (21st St)",
      new_name == "Officer Glen Pettit Corner" & limits == "Between 2nd Avenue and 3rd Avenue" ~ "Officer Glen Pettit Corner (3rd Ave)",

      # Keep everything else unchanged
      TRUE ~ new_name
    )) %>%
  filter(
    !(new_name %in% c("Firefighter Timothy M. Welty Street", "Mark and Stephen Colaio Way", "Michael A. Marti Street", "Vincent Cangelosi Memorial Way") & is.na(limits)),
    !(new_name == "Liberty Oaks 9/11 Memorial" & zip_code == 11225),
  )

# Merge geometries back in
total_edits <- total_edits %>%
  left_join(total %>% select(new_name, geometry), by = "new_name") %>%
  st_as_sf()

# Correct Plaza of Heroes (per Brad)
total_edits$geometry[total_edits$new_name == "Plaza of Heroes"] <- 
  st_sfc(st_point(c(-73.8965081574393, 40.72597950418192)), crs = st_crs(total_edits))
total_edits$limits[total_edits$new_name == "Plaza of Heroes"] <- "The intersection of Borden Avenue and 68th Street"

# Pretty variable names
pretty_name <- function(x) {x |> str_replace_all("_", " ") |> str_to_title()}
```

# Create data viz for the website
```{r}
# Dark-mode theme shared by all three visualizations
theme_911 <- function() {
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
    theme(
      plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "#222222", color = NA),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#222222", color = NA),
      legend.background = element_rect(fill = "#222222", color = NA),
      legend.key        = element_rect(fill = "#222222", color = NA),

      plot.title = element_text(color = "white", size = 18, face = "bold", hjust = 0),

      axis.title = element_text(color = "white"),
      axis.text  = element_text(color = "white"),
      axis.line  = element_line(color = "white"),
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),

      legend.text = element_text(color = "white"),
      legend.title = element_text(color = "white", face = "bold"))}

# 1. 9/11 Street Co-Namings Over Time
co_namings_year <- table(total_edits$enactment_year, useNA = "no") |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  rename(enactment_year = Var1, n = Freq) |>
  arrange(enactment_year)

p_year <- ggplot(co_namings_year, aes(x = enactment_year, y = n, group=1, 
  text = paste0("<b>", enactment_year, "</b>", "<br>", n, " co-namings"))) +
  geom_line(color="white", linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point(color="white", size = 3) +
  labs(title = "9/11 Street Co-Namings Over Time", x = "Year", y = "Number of co-namings") +
  scale_x_discrete(
    breaks = levels(co_namings_year$enactment_year)[
      as.numeric(levels(co_namings_year$enactment_year)) %% 4 == 0
    ]
  ) +
  theme_911()

p_year <- ggplotly(p_year, tooltip = "text") %>%
  layout(
    title = list(text = "9/11 Street Co-Namings Over Time", x = 0.5, xanchor = "center", font = list(size = 16, color = "white")),
    margin = list(t = 60, r = 30, b = 50, l = 50),
    hoverlabel = list(bgcolor = "#222222", bordercolor = "white", font = list(color = "white"))) %>%
  config(responsive = TRUE)

p_year

# 2. Who is honored?
type_counts <- table(total_edits$type, useNA = "no") |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  rename(type = Var1, n = Freq) |>
  arrange(desc(n)) |>
  mutate(type = factor(type, levels = type))

type_colors <- c(
  "FDNY/EMS"            = "red",
  "Police"              = "blue",
  "First Responder"    = "purple",
  "Volunteer"          = "green",
  "Civilian Casualty" = "white",
  "Community"         = "yellow",
  "Other Memorial" = "gray"
)

# Add gray for any unexpected type
missing_colors <- setdiff(type_counts$type, names(type_colors))

if (length(missing_colors) > 0) {
  type_colors[missing_colors] <- "black"
}

p_type <- ggplot(type_counts, aes(fill = type, values = n)) +
  geom_waffle(n_rows = 12, size = 0.25, colour = "#222222", flip = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = type_colors, breaks = levels(type_counts$type)) +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(title = "Who is honored?", fill = NULL) +
  theme_911() +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_blank(),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = "bottom",
  ) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 4, byrow = TRUE))

# 3. How were they honored?
land_use_counts <- total_edits %>%
  filter(!is.na(land_use)) %>%
  count(land_use, sort = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(land_use = reorder(land_use, n))

p_land_use <- ggplot(land_use_counts, aes(x = n, y = land_use,
  text = paste0("<b>", land_use, "</b><br>", n, " memorials"))) +
  geom_col(fill = "white", width = 0.7) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = pretty_breaks(n = 6), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.08))) +
  labs(title = "How were they honored?", x = "Number of memorials", y = NULL) +
  theme_911()

p_land_use <- ggplotly(p_land_use, tooltip = "text") %>%
  layout(
    title = list(text = "How were they honored?", x = 0.5, xanchor = "center", font = list(size = 16, color = "white")),
    margin = list(t = 60, r = 30, b = 50, l = 50)) %>%
  config(responsive = TRUE)

p_land_use

# Save widgets
saveWidget(p_year, "../docs/p_year.html", selfcontained = TRUE)
ggsave("../docs/p_type.png", plot = p_type, width = 4.5, height = 4.5, dpi = 300, bg = "#222222")
saveWidget(p_land_use, "../docs/p_land_use.html", selfcontained = TRUE)
```

# Create New Map
```{r}
# Build popup HTML
vals <- total_edits |> st_drop_geometry()

popup_html <- map_chr(seq_len(nrow(vals)), function(i) {
  
  vals_list <- vals[i, ] |> as.list()
  # Popup title
  title <- htmlEscape(as.character(vals_list$new_name))
  # Remove fields that will be displayed separately
  body_fields <- vals_list[!names(vals_list) %in% c("new_name", "biographical_information")]
  # Remove fields that are NA for this row
  body_fields <- body_fields[!map_lgl(body_fields, ~is.null(.x) || length(.x) == 0 || is.na(.x))]
  
  # Metadata fields
  rows <- map2_chr(
    names(body_fields),
    body_fields,
    ~sprintf(
      "<div style='
          font-size:12px;
          line-height:1.35;
          margin-bottom:3px;'>
         <span style='font-weight:bold;'>%s:</span> %s
       </div>",
      
      # Don't apply pretty_name() to URL
      htmlEscape(
        if (.x == "URL") {
          .x
        } else {
          pretty_name(.x)
        }),
      
      htmlEscape(as.character(.y))))

  # Information section
  bio <- vals_list$biographical_information

  if (is.null(bio) || length(bio) == 0 || is.na(bio)) {
    bio_section <- ""
  } else {
    bio_section <- sprintf(
      "<hr style='margin:8px 0 5px 0;'>

       <div style='
           font-weight:bold;
           font-size:12px;
           margin-bottom:4px;'>
         Information
       </div>

       <div style='
           max-height:140px;
           overflow-y:auto;
           overflow-x:hidden;
           white-space:normal;
           font-size:12px;
           line-height:1.35;
           padding-right:4px;'>
         %s
       </div>",
      htmlEscape(as.character(bio)))}

  paste0(
    "<div style='
        max-width:320px;
        max-height:300px;
        overflow-y:auto;
        overflow-x:hidden;
        padding-right:4px;'>",

      # Sticky title
      "<div style='
          position:sticky;
          top:0;
          background:#292929;
          z-index:100;
          padding-bottom:5px;
          margin-bottom:6px;
          border-bottom:1px solid #444;
          font-size:15px;
          font-weight:bold;'>",
        title,
      "</div>",
      
      paste(rows, collapse = ""),
      bio_section,
      
    "</div>")
})


# Geometry indices
line_idx <- which(st_geometry_type(total_edits) %in% c("LINESTRING", "MULTILINESTRING"))
point_idx <- which(st_geometry_type(total_edits) == "POINT")

# Find Type column regardless of capitalization
type_col <- names(total_edits)[tolower(names(total_edits)) == "type"]

if (length(type_col) != 1) {
  stop("Could not uniquely identify the Type column. Found: ", paste(type_col, collapse = ", "))}

# Type values
type_values <- total_edits[[type_col]]

# Colors based on Type
type_colors <- case_when(
  type_values == "FDNY/EMS"          ~ "red",
  type_values == "Police"            ~ "blue",
  type_values == "First Responder"   ~ "purple",
  type_values == "Volunteer"         ~ "green",
  type_values == "Civilian Casualty" ~ "white",
  type_values == "Community"         ~ "yellow",
  type_values == "Other Memorial"    ~ "black",
  TRUE                               ~ "gray"
)

# Memorial types
memorial_types <- c("FDNY/EMS", "Police", "First Responder", "Volunteer", "Civilian Casualty", "Community", "Other Memorial")

# Dark-mode colors
dark_bg <- "#1f1f1f"
dark_panel <- "#292929"
dark_border <- "#444444"
dark_text <- "#eeeeee"
dark_muted <- "#aaaaaa"

# Build map
readRenviron(".Renviron")
carto_key <- Sys.getenv("CARTO_KEY")

map <- leaflet() %>%
  addTiles(
    urlTemplate = paste0(
      "https://{s}.basemaps.cartocdn.com/rastertiles/dark_all/{z}/{x}/{y}.png?key=",
      carto_key
    ),
    attribution = '&copy; <a href="https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright">OpenStreetMap</a>, &copy; <a href="https://carto.com/attributions">CARTO</a>',
    options = tileOptions(
      subdomains = c("a", "b", "c", "d"),
      maxZoom = 20
    )
  )

# Add each Type as its own Leaflet group
for (type in memorial_types) {
  idx <- which(type_values == type)
  if (length(idx) == 0) next
  
  # Separate lines and points
  type_line_idx <- idx[st_geometry_type(total_edits[idx, ]) %in% c("LINESTRING", "MULTILINESTRING")]
  type_point_idx <- idx[st_geometry_type(total_edits[idx, ]) == "POINT"]
  
# Lines
if (length(type_line_idx) > 0) {
  # White outline / casing
  map <- map %>%
    addPolylines(
      data = total_edits[type_line_idx, ],
      color = "white",
      weight = 7,
      opacity = 1,
      group = type
    )
  
  # Colored line
  map <- map %>%
    addPolylines(
      data = total_edits[type_line_idx, ],
      popup = popup_html[type_line_idx],
      popupOptions = popupOptions(
        maxWidth = 340,
        minWidth = 220,
        closeButton = TRUE,
        className = "dark-popup"
      ),
      color = type_colors[type_line_idx],
      weight = 4,
      opacity = 1,
      label = ~new_name,
      group = type
    )
}
  
  # Points
  if (length(type_point_idx) > 0) {
    map <- map %>%
      addCircleMarkers(
        data = total_edits[type_point_idx, ],
        popup = popup_html[type_point_idx],
        popupOptions = popupOptions(
          maxWidth = 340,
          minWidth = 220,
          closeButton = TRUE,
          className = "dark-popup"
        ),
        radius = 5,
        stroke = TRUE,
        color = "white",
        weight = 1.5,
        fillColor = type_colors[type_point_idx],
        fillOpacity = 0.9,
        label = ~new_name,
        group = type
      )}}

# Type filter / legend
map <- map %>%
  addLayersControl(
    overlayGroups = memorial_types, 
    options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE, position = "topright")
    ) %>%
  onRender("
    function(el, x) {
      var map = this;
      map.setMinZoom(10);
      
      var control = el.querySelector('.leaflet-control-layers');
      if (control) {
        control.style.marginTop = '60px';
      }
    }
  ")

# Custom dark-mode UI
map <- map %>%
  htmlwidgets::onRender("
    function(el, x) {

      var paths = el.querySelectorAll(
        '.leaflet-overlay-pane path'
      );

      paths.forEach(function(path) {
        path.style.strokeLinecap = 'round';
        path.style.strokeLinejoin = 'round';
      });

      var map = this;

      /* =============================================
         TWIN TOWERS
         ============================================= */
      
      var towerIcon = L.divIcon({
        className: 'twin-tower-icon',
        html:
          '<div class=\"tower-marker\">' +
            '<div class=\"tower\"></div>' +
            '<div class=\"tower\"></div>' +
          '</div>',
        iconSize: [30, 42],
        iconAnchor: [15, 42]
      });
      
      L.marker(
        [40.711592, -74.013211],
        {icon: towerIcon, interactive: false}
      ).addTo(map);

      /* =============================================
         GLOBAL MAP UI
         ============================================= */

      var style = document.createElement('style');

        /* -----------------------------------------

      `;

      document.head.appendChild(style);

      /* =============================================
         SEARCH CONTROL
         ============================================= */

      var searchControl = L.control({position: 'topleft'});

      searchControl.onAdd = function(map) {

        var div = L.DomUtil.create(
          'div',
          'leaflet-control memorial-search'
        );

        div.innerHTML =
          '<input id=\"memorial-search-input\" ' +
          'type=\"text\" ' +
          'placeholder=\"Search for a memorial\" ' +
          'autocomplete=\"off\">' +

          '<div id=\"memorial-search-results\"></div>';

        L.DomEvent.disableClickPropagation(div);
        L.DomEvent.disableScrollPropagation(div);

        return div;
      };

      searchControl.addTo(map);

      var input = document.getElementById('memorial-search-input');
      var results = document.getElementById('memorial-search-results');

      /* =============================================
         SEARCH
         ============================================= */

      input.addEventListener('input', function() {
        var query = input.value.toLowerCase().trim();
        results.innerHTML = '';
        if (query.length === 0) return;
        var matches = [];
        
        map.eachLayer(function(layer) {

          if (!map.hasLayer(layer)) return;
          if (!layer.options || !layer.options.label) return;

          var name = layer.options.label;

          if (typeof name !== 'string') {
            if (name && name.options && name.options.content) {
              name = name.options.content;
            } else {
              return;
            }
          }

          name = String(name);

          if (name.toLowerCase().includes(query)) {
            matches.push({
              name: name,
              layer: layer
            });
          }
        });

        if (matches.length === 0) {
          results.innerHTML =
            '<div class=\"memorial-search-result\" ' +
            'style=\"cursor:default;color:#888;\">' +
            'No memorials found' +
            '</div>';
          return;
        }

        matches.forEach(function(match) {
          var item = document.createElement('div');
          item.className = 'memorial-search-result';
          item.textContent = match.name;

          item.addEventListener(
            'click',
            function() {
              var layer = match.layer;
              if (layer.getBounds) {
                var bounds = layer.getBounds();
                if (bounds.isValid()) {
                  map.fitBounds(bounds, {padding: [40, 40]});
                }

              } else if (layer.getLatLng) {
                map.setView(layer.getLatLng(), 17);
              }

              if (layer.openPopup) {
                layer.openPopup();
              }

              results.innerHTML = '';
            }
          );

          results.appendChild(item);
        });
      });

      /* =============================================
         STYLE LEGEND
         ============================================= */
      var colors = {
        'FDNY/EMS': 'red',
        'Police': 'blue',
        'First Responder': 'purple',
        'Volunteer': 'green',
        'Civilian Casualty': 'white',
        'Community': 'yellow',
        'Other Memorial': 'black'
      };

      var control = el.querySelector('.leaflet-control-layers');

      if (control) {
        var heading = document.createElement('div');
        heading.innerHTML = 'Filter by memorial type';

        heading.style.fontWeight = '600';
        heading.style.fontSize = '12px';
        heading.style.color = '#eeeeee';
        heading.style.marginBottom = '5px';
        heading.style.paddingBottom = '5px';
        heading.style.borderBottom =
          '1px solid #444';

        control.insertBefore(heading, control.querySelector('.leaflet-control-layers-list'));
        var labels = control.querySelectorAll('.leaflet-control-layers-overlays label');
        labels.forEach(function(label) {
          var text = label.textContent.trim();
          var color = colors[text];

          if (!color) return;

          var dot = document.createElement('span');
          dot.style.display = 'inline-block';

          dot.style.width = '10px';
          dot.style.height = '10px';
          dot.style.borderRadius = '50%';
          dot.style.border = '1px solid white';
          dot.style.backgroundColor = color;
          dot.style.marginLeft = '5px';
          dot.style.marginRight = '5px';
          dot.style.verticalAlign = 'middle';

          var checkbox = label.querySelector('input');

          if (checkbox) {
            checkbox.insertAdjacentElement('afterend', dot);
          }

        });
      }
    }
  ")
```
